meters.description: Distance in meters. Must be finite.

degrees.description: Rotation in degrees. Internally stored with 0.01 degree precision.

metersInput.description: Meters accepted in writes. Out of range → bad_value.

degreesInput.description: Degrees accepted in writes. Out of range → bad_value.

offset.description: A full offset: translation in the playspace's un-rotated base frame plus yaw.

partialOffset.description: Any non-empty subset of offset fields. Applied atomically (all validated first); rotation is applied before x/y/z.

stackId.description: Name of an offset stack, chosen by the client (e.g. "vrcleash"). Any client may read or write any stack.

pivot.description: What a rotation write turns around. hmd: the headset stays in place (default, unless Universe-Centered Rotation is enabled in OVRAS, which makes origin the default). origin: the playspace origin; x/z are not adjusted.

persist.description: false: removed when the connection that last wrote it closes. true: kept until reset (or OVRAS restarts).

stacks.description: All existing stacks, sorted by id.

offsetPath.description: The user's own offset, or a stack's offset when the request carries `stack`.

totalPath.description: Read-only: user offset plus all stacks, i.e. what is applied to the playspace.

stacksPath.description: Read-only: list of all offset stacks.
